strategies.method: Longs priced at the best ASK, shorts at the best BID (never mid) plus Derive taker fees per contract (min(0.03% × index, 12.5% × premium)); the $0.50 per-order base fee is added when you size. Only resting quotes with size count. Every short is covered by a long of the same type: same-expiry shorts sit further OTM than the long and never exceed it in quantity; calendar/diagonal shorts expire BEFORE the long and are at the same or a further-OTM strike. Probability of profit uses a lognormal with that expiry's ATM implied vol; EV(RV) uses 30d realized vol. Calendars are valued at the short expiry with the long leg repriced at its current IV (sticky strike), so their numbers depend on IV staying put.
strategies.thinRule: Assets with < $5M Derive options OI or < 20 two-sided quotes are marked thin and excluded from the overall / by-structure top lists (still shown per asset).
strategies.score: score = 40 × P(profit) + 30 × EV under realized vol (as share of max loss, clipped ±50%) + 15 × principal recovered upfront + 15 × (1 − slippage vs mid as share of max loss). Ranks trade-offs; does not predict a winner.

pool.caveat: Docs say "up to"; the actual weekly amount is shown only in the app (app.derive.xyz/rewards) and is not available from a public API we could find.

facts.label: Retail Trading Rewards Program
facts.allocation: Rewards are distributed on a pro-rata basis according to the fees you pay.
facts.epoch: At the end of each weekly epoch, rewards are allocated proportionally based on the fees you paid.
facts.audit: All trading activity is subject to an audit before rewards are finalized. Behavior that violates the ToS is strictly prohibited and will result in disqualification.
facts.payout: Typically, rewards are paid out one week after the epoch ends.

facts.label: DRV token & emissions
facts.trading_pool: Up to 50,000 DRV allocated for trading and liquidity programs.
facts.buybacks: 35% of protocol revenue allocated for DRV buybacks
facts.unstake: stDRV (non-transferrable, 7-day unlock, or 20% instant unlock penalty)

facts.label: Staking Rewards Program
facts.staking_weekly: currently 250,000 stDRV per week, subject to change

facts.label: Institutional Trading Rewards (market makers)
facts.wash: Wash trading is strictly prohibited and results in disqualification from all reward programs.

facts.label: Trading fees
facts.rfq: 2-leg option spreads** like straddles, verticals, and calendars pay zero fee on their second leg.

cases.label: Perps, maker (resting limit orders)
cases.note: Maker earns the spread instead of paying it, but gets filled when price moves against the order (adverse selection), not modeled.

assumptions: Retail trading rewards are pro-rata on FEES paid (not volume): your weekly stDRV = pool × your fees ÷ all fees (official docs, cited).

Exchange-wide fees are ESTIMATED from Derive's trailing-24h ticker stats × 7 at list rates (taker 3 bps + maker 1 bps of notional, options capped at 12.5% of premium, $0.50/$0.01 base per trade). Market-maker discounts/rebates and RFQ discounts make true fees lower, which would make rewards per fee dollar HIGHER; a busier week makes them LOWER.
Pool size uses the docs figure ("50,000 stDRV weekly for trading programs", stated as "up to"); the live weekly amount is only in the app.
$10k of volume is assumed to be traded in one week, in $2k orders (per-order base fee).
Rewards are paid in stDRV (staked, non-transferable): 7-day unlock or 20% instant-unlock penalty per the token docs, so the "instant unstake" column values rewards at 80%.
caveats: Wash trading / self-matching is prohibited; all activity is audited before rewards finalize and ToS violations are disqualified (official docs).
Your fees are certain; rewards are not: other farmers dilute the pool, the pool can change, and DRV price can fall before you can unstake.
Spread + price-impact is often the bigger cost than fees, especially in options; round-tripping also carries market risk while open.
Market-maker DRV pools (institutional program, by score with $50M+ 28-day volume) are not reachable for retail.
